# nRnWorld
> Öppna Windows-verktyg, AI-agenter och ljudmotorer. 19 projekt, direkta nedladdningar, källkod på GitHub under @nRn-World.

## Projekt
- [ShadowPaw: Noir Typist](https://nrnworld.one/shadowpaw): Retro noir typing thriller where words become powers. Web browser. Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/ShadowPaw/ | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/ShadowPaw
- [Doggy-Player](https://nrnworld.one/doggyplayer): High-fidelity audio & video desktop media player with customized skinning and EQ. Windows/Linux. Nedladdning: https://github.com/nRn-World/Doggy-Player/releases/latest
- [WindowsSmartTaskbar](https://nrnworld.one/windowssmarttaskbar): Sleek Windows system tray utility for smart application organization. Windows 10/11. Nedladdning: https://github.com/nRn-World/WindowsSmartTaskbar/releases/latest
- [NOBreak-Audio-Builder](https://nrnworld.one/nobreakaudiobuilder): Desktop audio mixer for creating seamless, gapless compilations. Windows/macOS. Nedladdning: https://github.com/nRn-World/NOBreak-Audio-Builder/releases/latest
- [OctosArmy](https://nrnworld.one/octosarmy): Multi-agent AI orchestration system for autonomous file management. Windows/Linux. Nedladdning: https://github.com/nRn-World/OctosArmy/releases/latest
- [TheSilentRoom1986](https://nrnworld.one/thesilentroom1986): 1980s-inspired underground typing game defying the regime. Web browser. Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/TheSilentRoom1986/
- [Farm-Guardian-TD](https://nrnworld.one/farmguardiantd): Mobile animal tower-defense and merge game built with Phaser 3. Web/PWA. Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/Farm-Guardian-TD/
- [NeonPathPuzzle](https://nrnworld.one/neonpathpuzzle): Neon light pathfinding and circuit alignment logic game. Web/PWA. Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/NeonPathPuzzle/
- [DoneTogether](https://nrnworld.one/donetogether): Real-time collaborative planning app for teams and friends. Web/PWA. Live: https://donetogether.vercel.app/
- [NexNote](https://nrnworld.one/nexnote): Minimalist distraction-free markdown note-taking suite with KaTeX. Web/PWA. Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/NexNote/
- [SecretPromts](https://nrnworld.one/secretpromts): Curated AI prompt discovery directory, tester, and playground. Web/PWA. Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/SecretPromts/
- [SiteScannerPro](https://nrnworld.one/sitescannerpro): Website health analysis for SEO, performance, security, and accessibility. Web/CLI. GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/SiteScannerPro
- [GLOBAL_EMERGENCY](https://nrnworld.one/globalemergency): Global emergency information and travel safety PWA. Web/PWA. Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/GLOBAL_EMERGENCY/
- [PrivateLinkSaver](https://nrnworld.one/privatelinksaver): Secure Chrome extension to privately save and manage bookmarks. Chrome Extension. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/
- [BUGRAIDER](https://nrnworld.one/bugraider): AI agent skill that hunts bugs, security flaws, and dead code. CLI / AI Tool. GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/BUGRAIDER
- [BluetoothSafetyLock](https://nrnworld.one/bluetoothsafetylock): Automated proximity lock utility for Windows when Bluetooth disconnects. Windows 10/11. Nedladdning: https://github.com/nRn-World/BluetoothSafetyLock/releases/latest
- [FlashVideoDownloader](https://nrnworld.one/flashvideodownloader): Lightweight video stream discovery and downloader script. Python/CLI. GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/FlashVideoDownloader
- [NotePin](https://nrnworld.one/notepin): Minimalist sticky note desktop pin utility. Windows 10/11. Nedladdning: https://github.com/nRn-World/NotePin/releases/latest
- [ParkeraiSthlm](https://nrnworld.one/parkeraisthlm): Realtidskarta för gatuparkering i Stockholm med officiella taxezoner. Web/PWA. Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/ParkeraiSthlm/
